content: गन्धर्वः .²1 A celestial musician, a class of demi-gods regarded as the singers or musicians of gods, and said to give good and agreeable voice to girls; पतङ्गो वाचं मनसा बिभर्ति तां गन्धर्वोऽवदद्गर्भे अन्तः <ls>Rv. 10. 177. 2</ls>; <ls>Av. 11. 5. 2</ls>; सोमं शौचं ददावासां गन्धर्वश्च शुभां गिरम् <ls>Y. 1. 71</ls>. .²2 A singer in general; <ls>Mb. 7. 57. 4</ls>. .²3 A horse; <ls>Mb. 3</ls>. .²4 The musk-deer. .²5 The soul after death and previous to its being born again; तस्यासीद्दुहिता गन्धर्वगृहीता <ls>Bṛ. Up. 3. 3. 1</ls>. .²6 The black cuckoo. .²7 The sun. .²8 A sage, pious man; <ls>Vāj. 32. 7</ls>.
